differential.name: End‑stage renal disease due to diabetic nephropathy
differential.rationale: Advanced CKD (stages 3‑4) with proteinuria, diabetes, weight loss on dialysis and awaiting transplant.

differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Long‑standing hypertension and metabolic syndrome contributing to progressive CKD in a middle‑aged adult.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Documented anemia in the setting of stage 4 CKD where reduced erythropoietin production is common.

differential.name: Major depressive disorder secondary to chronic illness and intimate partner abuse
differential.rationale: Presence of stress, limited social contact, abuse history, and chronic disease burden predispose to depression.

differential.name: Dyslipidemia (hyperlipidemia)
differential.rationale: Metabolic syndrome and diabetes with borderline LDL/total cholesterol values indicating ongoing lipid disorder.
